sql: select count(*) as open_positions, count(distinct market_ticker) as distinct_tickers, count(*) filter (where strategy ilike $$%mmsell%$$) as mmsell_open, count(distinct market_ticker) filter (where strategy ilike $$%mmsell%$$) as mmsell_distinct_tickers, (select count(*) from mmsell_position_ticks where captured_at > now() - interval $$1 day$$) as ticks_24h from paper_trades where status = $$open$$
